comment: Dr. VanDerwerken was not only a very good professor, but you can tell that she enjoys teaching and wants her students to perform well and enjoy the material. She effectively answers any questions asked of her to make sure everyone understands the lesson. She also allows students to create a cheat sheet to use on tests, which is definitely a plus.

Dr. Vanderwerken was a very kind, sweet lady. I did not mind her heavy lectures because she was always so nice and tried to make them as interesting as possible. However, she did seem to rely on her notes most of the time and at times did not remember how to teach the material. If you have never taken Econ before this professor might be too hard.

Professor VanDerwerken is a great teacher, and is easygoing. If you try in her class and study, without just relying on the cheat sheet, you can do well. Complete the weekly MindTap homework, study somewhat for tests, listen in class and you will most likely do well. I really loved her and she was always around for extra help.

Professor VanDerWerken was my favorite professor last semester. She allows a cheat sheet on all the tests as a way to get students to study more -- by the time I made it I barely used it on the tests! Shes very helpful outside of class. I suggest reading the chapters after class because she does leave out a few things but overall great professor!
Took for Microeconomics. Very good professor, easygoing. Not a ton of work, but learned a lot. Lets you make a cheat sheet for tests, and tests are fair. Would definitely take again!
